verdict.rationale: Porkbun documents an aftermarket path: a browsable domain marketplace with server-side filters, plus fixed-price expired-domain closeouts that can be searched and bought. Search returns availability and pricing across hundreds of TLDs, but nothing says premium-tier pricing is flagged or shown, and no broker or acquisition service for taken names is described. Missing for 10: explicit premium-domain pricing in search results, a broker/acquisition path for registered names, details on marketplace purchase flow, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a power user, premium and aftermarket domains are first-class — premium pricing shown in search, and a marketplace or broker path for taken names

citations.quote: Browse the domain marketplace with server-side filters (query, TLD, SLD length, sort)
Search and **buy expired-domain closeouts** — fixed descending price, no bidding, first buyer takes it.
Check domain availability and pricing across hundreds of TLDs (no auth required)
